items.markdown:
A sound generator is `a device or software that creates audio frequencies, electronic waveforms, or simulated acoustic effects for testing, music production, or ambient masking`.

You can use a free web browser tool like the [Online Tone Generator](https://onlinetonegenerator.com/) to instantly play specific frequencies and test audio equipment or your hearing.[[1]](https://www.onlinemictest.com/tone-generator/)[[2]](https://hzgenerator.com/)

### Types of Sound Generators

- **Frequency & Tone Generators:** Software or hardware that outputs precise mathematical waveforms like sine, square, triangle, or sawtooth waves.
- **AI Sound Effect Generators:** Tools that turn text prompts into realistic environmental noises, cinematic sounds, or audio samples.
- **Physical Noise Machines:** Dedicated hardware (such as fan-based white noise units) used for sleep therapy and blocking distractions.[[1]](https://onlinetonegenerator.com/)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15185905367632991602,catalogid:9152072550518833653,gpcid:4740159981333835276,mid:576462869032811535&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://lalals.com/sound-fx)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16886920324146986616,catalogid:3985344906954448184,gpcid:13356204108310676004,mid:576462774757134093&ibp=oshop)

### Common Uses

- **Audio Testing:** Calibrating speakers, headphones, amplifiers, and recording gear.
- **Health & Wellness:** Masking tinnitus ringing or playing soothing frequencies for meditation.
- **Creative Media:** Generating custom sound effects and Foley audio for video games and film.[[1]](https://lalals.com/sound-fx)[[2]](https://hzgenerator.com/)[[3]](https://mynoise.net/NoiseMachines/binauralBrainwaveGenerator.php)
